prompt: How should we handle third-party OAuth application consent in our Microsoft 365 tenant under the current ISM?
assertions: End users prevented from granting consent to third-party OAuth applications — consent by an authorised administrator only (ISM-2137)
OAuth application consents reviewed at least every six months, revoking unused apps and excessive permissions (ISM-2138)
Central logging of consent grants, token issuance and token use (ISM-2139)
OAuth device code flow disabled unless required; where required, restricted to authorised accounts and managed devices (ISM-2140)
Frames why: consent phishing and token theft are current attack paths; ties to session/token binding and revocation controls in the same release
